correctness.rationale: An induced line-graph P3 has disjoint premise edges covering both endpoints of the middle edge. For every absent uv induced on V(S), selected ux and vy are necessarily disjoint by triangle-freeness and directly imply uv. The classical Boolean-fibre formula for closure-lattice Möbius inversion sums (-1)^|S| over generators; inclusion-exclusion on uncovered new vertices gives the signed vertex-cover sum, forced neighbors of V(A) split off, and remaining vertex covers complement independent sets in G[W]. Forest leaf recurrence I_F(-1)=-I_{F-N[u]}(-1) bounds values by 1; C_n two-state transfer eigenvalues exp(±π i/3) prove cycle formula. Independent reconstruction enumerated all 436 labelled triangle-free graphs of orders 3–5, checking closure and 18,570 interval Möbius values by direct recurrence. One-round proof covers all n; finite checks do not.
